items.docs:
Tries to return a sendbird access token for a user. To do this,
   we figure out what a user's sendbird-user-id in postgres,
   and we ask sendbird for a token. If no active ones exist, we
   create one.

Returns the one-way-hashed provider ID and the signed
   LD hash of that to use as js-secure-mode LD credentials
   without revealing any of our data/ids to LD.
